Class WaitlistController

java.lang.Object
com.example.eventparticipation.WaitlistController
public class WaitlistController extends Object
Controller handling waitlist business logic for an event.

This class is responsible for:

  • Running the lottery to move entrants from waiting to selected
  • Drawing a replacement entrant when a spot becomes available
  • Synchronizing derived event counts back to the top-level event document

Status model used in waitlist documents:

  • selectionStatus: waiting / selected / cancelled
  • responseStatus: pending / accepted / declined
  • finalStatus: enrolled

Count model used in the top-level event document:

  • waitingCount: number of waitlist docs with selectionStatus == waiting
  • selectedCount: number of waitlist docs with selectionStatus == selected and finalStatus != enrolled
  • enrolledCount: number of waitlist docs with finalStatus == enrolled

  • Method Details

    • runLottery

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<Void> runLottery(String eventId, int sampleSize)
      Runs a lottery for the specified event.

      The method:

      1. Loads all entrants currently marked as waiting
      2. Randomly selects up to sampleSize winners
      3. Marks winners as selected with responseStatus = pending
      4. Sends notifications where applicable
      5. Recomputes and persists accurate event counts
      Parameters:
      eventId - the Firestore ID of the event
      sampleSize - the maximum number of waiting entrants to select
      Returns:
      a task that completes when the lottery and count synchronization finish

    • drawReplacement

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<String> drawReplacement(String eventId)
      Draws exactly one replacement entrant from the waiting pool.

      The replacement entrant is moved to:

      • selectionStatus = selected
      • responseStatus = pending
      • finalStatus = null

      After the update, this method recomputes and persists the top-level event counts.

      Parameters:
      eventId - the Firestore ID of the event
      Returns:
      a task whose result is the selected entrant document ID, or null if none were available

    • inviteEntrantDirectly

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<Void> inviteEntrantDirectly(String eventId, String entrantId)
      Directly invites a specific entrant to a private event, bypassing the public lottery.

      The method atomically:

      1. Checks that a waitlist document does not already exist (or that the entrant previously cancelled / declined) so duplicate invites are blocked.
      2. Writes a waitlist document with selectionStatus = selected, responseStatus = pending.
      3. Appends a private-invite notification to the entrant's notification sub-collection using a fixed document id so the operation is idempotent.
      4. Increments selectedCount on the event document.

      The entrant can then accept or decline through the normal NotificationRepository.acceptInvitation(String, NotificationItem) / NotificationRepository.declineInvitation(String, NotificationItem) flow.

      Parameters:
      eventId - the Firestore ID of the event
      entrantId - the Firestore ID of the entrant to invite
      Returns:
      a task that completes when the invite is committed; the task fails with IllegalStateException if the entrant is already on the waitlist with an active status

    • syncEventCounts

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<Void> syncEventCounts(String eventId)
      Recomputes the derived counts for an event from the authoritative waitlist subcollection.

      This method scans all documents under events/{eventId}/waitlist and writes the following values back to the top-level event document:

      • waitingCount
      • selectedCount
      • enrolledCount

      This should be called after any operation that changes waitlist status, including:

      • lottery runs
      • replacement draws
      • accepting an invitation
      • declining an invitation
      • leaving the waitlist
      • promoting an entrant to co-organizer and removing them from waitlist
      Parameters:
      eventId - the Firestore ID of the event
      Returns:
      a task that completes when the event document has been updated
